summary: Assay worksheet for the KT12 protease analogue set run in human and rat liver microsomes and cryopreserved hepatocytes at 1 µM. CLint values retain their matrix-specific units and should not be compared numerically without scaling. Hepatocyte turnover revealed a clearance route missing from the microsomal screen, changing Kelbravik's shortlist; the depletion results alone do not identify the responsible enzyme.
